342:t_007:14.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We will now join $c and intercept the hostile creatures.」

342:t_007:15.en:
$$テッサ$$
「After enduring so many hardships since escaping $$メリダ島$$, this is a trivial accident for us.」

342:t_007:16.en:
$$テッサ$$
「All hands, rally! I will not allow anyone to die without my permission!」

342:t_007:18.en:
$$クルツ$$
「This gives me chills! It's been so long since $$テッサ$$ commanded us!」

342:t_007:19.en:
$$マオ$$
(You've had a hard time too, haven't you, $$テッサ$$...)

342:t_007:20.en:
$$クルーゾー$$
「All units, cover the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$! Don't let those monsters get close!」

342:t_008:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「But if we keep fighting like this when we cannot resupply...」

342:t_009:0.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「The enemies are being taken down...!」

342:t_009:1.en:
$$デュオ$$
「Are we getting reinforcements in a place like this!?」

342:t_010:0.en:
$$五飛$$
「Those are $$アンゲロイ$$s...! $$サイデリアル$$ has arrived!」

342:t_010:1.en:
$$トロワ$$
「But this is our first encounter with that black type.」

342:t_011:1.en:
$$クロウ$$
「No...! My Buster instincts tell me they're different!」

342:t_011:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「Since they are with $$アンゲロイ$$s, we should consider them $$サイデリアル$$ forces.」

342:t_011:5.en:
$$ヒルデ$$
「W-what...!? I can't move when I look at those enemies...!」

342:t_011:6.en:
$$ノイン$$
「This is impossible... My will to fight... is withering...」

342:t_011:8.en:
$$スズネ$$
「It isn't. It's awe before overwhelming power.」

342:t_011:10.en:
$$テイタニア$$
(I understand... I understand this feeling of giving up everything when exposed to overwhelming power...!)

342:t_011:11.en:
$$スズネ$$
「When faced with an adult's anger, a small child does everything possible to beg forgiveness.」

342:t_011:12.en:
$$スズネ$$
「The child doesn't rebel or resist. They apologize and fawn, laying bare their own helplessness, just waiting for the anger to pass.」

342:t_011:13.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
「...It's awe etched into humanity's genes... Those are... humanity's true enemies...」

342:t_011:16.en:
$$カレン$$
「Wasn't the fundamental calamity 《$$ガイオウ$$》 spoke of... $$バアル$$!?」

342:t_011:17.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「But... Looking at them, I can understand $$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$'s words...」

342:t_011:18.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Even when I saw the strongest $$次元獣$$s or $$ガイオウ$$, I never felt like this...」

342:t_011:20.en:
$$カトル$$
「Their power is dark... cold... and overwhelming...」

342:t_011:21.en:
$$デュオ$$
「...So these are the real bringers of death...」

342:t_011:23.en:
$$カレン$$
「This can't be happening... We've tried so hard to get this far...」

342:t_011:24.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...They must have... called us here... to show us that power...」

342:t_011:26.en:
$n
「I...! I refuse to bow to bastards like that!!」

342:t_011:29.en:
$$ヒイロ$$
「I don't care what they are... I'll just... fight anyone trying to eliminate me... with all my strength...」

342:t_011:30.en:
$$スザク$$
「...I once threw my life away... I have... nothing left to lose...」

342:t_011:31.en:
$$クロウ$$
「...$n. Apart from what I said earlier, I'll teach you some magic words for times like this.」

342:t_011:33.en:
$$クロウ$$
「If someone comes to break our hearts and steal our will, tell them...!」

342:t_011:37.en:
$$カレン$$
「You call yourselves the fundamental calamity!? What does it matter!」

342:t_011:38.en:
$$宗介$$
「What does it matter! We can fight!」

342:t_011:39.en:
$n
「What does it matter! We're still alive!」

342:t_011:40.en:
$$Ｃ．Ｃ．$$
(That's right... That is the power to surpass God.)

342:t_011:42.en:
$$テッサ$$
「...You've all made up your minds, haven't you?」

342:t_011:44.en:
$$テッサ$$
「We've hit rock bottom. If we can't fall any further, we'll just climb back up!」

342:t_011:46.en:
$$マオ$$
「I'll do it, no matter what we're up against...!」

342:t_011:49.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「They are enemies who seek to kill our hearts...!」

342:t_011:50.en:
$$ゼロ$$
「We'll resist with all our strength as long as we're alive!」

342:t_011:52.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「That's right! That is the duty of all living beings!」

342:t_011:53.en:
$$桂$$
「I don't give a damn if they're the rumored fundamental calamity!」

342:t_011:54.en:
$$宗介$$
「We'll overcome them with all our strength!」

342:t_012:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Even those black $$アンゲロイ$$s have power beyond anything in $$サイデリアル$$'s forces we've seen so far.」

342:t_012:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「They seek to break our hearts through awe... They're $$サイデリアル$$'s trump card...」

342:t_012:3.en:
$$桂$$
「Are they our true enemies... humanity's fundamental calamity...?」

342:t_012:4.en:
$$クロウ$$
「Watch out! Here they come again!」

342:t_013:0.en:
$$スザク$$
「Their strength... is on a different level...!」

342:t_013:1.en:
$$ゼクス$$
「Even those black $$アンゲロイ$$s have power beyond anything in $$サイデリアル$$'s forces we've seen so far...!」

342:t_013:2.en:
$$ロジャー$$
「They seek to break our hearts through awe... They're $$サイデリアル$$'s trump card...」
